First notes drafted and waiting for a yes
Budget bands flagged for a same-day reply

challenge:
A hotel that just reopened or an airline that just launched a route needs content now. That is the best moment to pitch a creator partnership, and it passes in weeks. Spotting those moments by hand means reading trade news every day, then hunting for a marketing contact that is rarely published.

On the other side, inbound briefs arrived as plain form emails, with no way to tell a large budget from a small one or to answer the sender while they waited.
built_intro: Outbound that finds its own leads, and inbound that sorts itself.

built.title: A trigger radar
built.text: Every week an agent scans for openings, renovations, route launches and campaigns, and keeps only events from the last 30 days with a public source.

built.title: Scoring
built.text: Each prospect gets a score out of ten with the reason written down, so the strongest fits rise to the top.

built.title: Contact finding
built.text: A second pass checks the event and looks for the right marketing or press contact on the brand's own pages.

built.title: Drafted first notes
built.text: Outreach is drafted around the event itself and saved as a draft. Nothing is sent without approval.

built.title: A pipeline ledger
built.text: One running record of every thread: status, date, contact, event, score and next step, with repeats suppressed.

built.title: Self-routing briefs
built.text: Inbound briefs reach the inbox with every field laid out, larger budgets are flagged PRIORITY, and the sender gets an instant reply with the most relevant case study.

ai_title: Agents find the moment. A person sends the note.
ai_text: The agents do the reading, scoring, contact hunting and first drafts. The founder reviews a short list and approves what goes out. Every prospect carries the source of its trigger event, so nothing rests on a guess.
ai_points: Weekly scans for openings, launches and campaigns
A score and a written reason for every prospect
Drafts only: a person approves every send
